claim_text: Not all plastics labelled biodegradable will fully biodegrade under marine conditions.

evidence.passage: complete biodegradation of plastics occurs in conditions that are rarely, if ever, met in marine environments
evidence.source_title: Biodegradable Plastics Are Not the Answer to Reducing Marine Litter, Says UN
